content: Configurable array size The size of an ApplicationArray- DataType (in terms of the number of elements) is configured by means of the value of attribute ApplicationArrayElement . maxNumberOfElements . For the purpose of referring to an element of an ApplicationArrayDataType within a software-component description, the element’s index runs from 0 to the value of maxNumberOfElements -1.
